description: TeamCoach: consume the new `candidates` SSE event and render recommendation cards (sprite, name, types, role, reason) each with a one-click 'Add to team' button that calls setSlot on the next empty slot. Consume `team_updated` to reflect conversational adds. Add an onTeamChanged callback so TeamWorkbench reloads the team (slots + analysis refresh) after any add. Extend lib/api coachAskStream handlers with onCandidates/onTeamUpdated. Handle team-full and duplicate gracefully. Keep citation rendering.
title: Frontend coach: recommendation cards, Add buttons, live refresh
